# rnmapbox

> Community-supported React Native libraries for Mapbox on iOS and Android: @rnmapbox/maps for maps, and @rnmapbox/navigation for turn-by-turn navigation with the Mapbox Navigation SDK v3. @rnmapbox/navigation requires the New Architecture; both work with Expo development builds, not Expo Go.

## @rnmapbox/maps

- [Install](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/install): npm, iOS, Android and Expo setup
- [Components](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/components/MapView): MapView, Camera, sources, layers, annotations, offline
- [Examples](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/examples): example screens with source code
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rnmapbox/maps)

## @rnmapbox/navigation

- [Overview](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/overview): turn-by-turn navigation for React Native, status, requirements and approaches
- [Install](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/install): iOS, Android and Expo config plugin setup
- [Getting started](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/getting-started): request a route and start guidance on an @rnmapbox/maps MapView
- [NavigationView](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/navigation-view): the Navigation SDK's full-screen turn-by-turn UI
- [RNNavigationView](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/rn-navigation-view): a turn-by-turn UI written in React Native
- [API reference](https://rnmapbox.github.io/docs/navigation/api)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rnmapbox/navigation)
